notes.title: Huddle Genius – Version 1.01u Update
notes.content:
Version 1.01u is now live and addresses a couple of important issues:

🛠 Critical Fix

Resolved a crash caused by CSV files not being read properly. Your exposure imports should now load smoothly without errors.

⚡ Feature Adjustment

The Ignore Shared Exposure setting now applies to all core team players, not just soft targets — giving you more consistent draft control.

These changes should make drafting and exposure management more stable and predictable.

Happy drafting! 🏈

notes.content: RBs will never be picked more than WRs initially as a goal in any strategy.

notes.title: Huddle Genius – Version 1.01t Update
notes.content:
Version 1.01t is here with smarter targeting and smoother drafting performance:

Improved end-of-round targeting logic – especially for picks 1–3 and 9–12 – making better decisions on when to pick and allowing back-to-back target handling.

Added caching for round targets to speed up the Drafting Screen and reduce performance hiccups.

These changes should make drafting feel more natural and responsive.

Happy drafting! 🏈

notes.content:

notes.title: Huddle Genius – Version 1.01s Update
notes.content:
Version 1.01s is live and brings several important fixes and improvements:

Soft targets and QB targets will now attempt to use the latest valid round instead of stopping at the earliest.

Hot Swap functionality is working again.

Prevented saving during the loading process, which could previously reset your settings if the program was closed irregularly.

Fixed issues with the % Draft Strategy section.

These changes should make drafting smoother and more reliable.

Happy drafting! 🏈

notes.title: Huddle Genius – Version 1.01r Update
notes.content:
We’ve rolled out Version 1.01r with a mix of fixes and tweaks aimed at smoothing your drafting experience:

Fixed an issue where Hotswap was incorrectly flagged as valid.

Adjusted default bye week ratios – RB now at 40% and WR at 44%. (You can set these in your preferences – though we still recommend avoiding heavy bye-week overlap.)

Hotfix for Strategy Listings crashing in certain cases.

Improved round movement logic to reduce cases of skipping positional picks incorrectly.

Draft Manager can now better handle stressful draft changes without falling apart.

It’s not perfect yet, but we’re getting closer to a smoother, more reliable drafting tool.

Happy drafting! 🏈

notes.title: 1.01Q - Simple HotFix
notes.content: This is a simple hotfix to address picking a quarterback, manually, out of order. We will rework our Quarterback targets if you do this. This only happens if you use the "SEARCH" option when selecting a quarterback that is not on your list. It is still highly advised to avoid this.

notes.title: Huddle Genius 1.01k Update – Team Synergy Report, ADP Fixes
notes.content:
We’ve just shipped update 1.01k of Huddle Genius, and it brings some helpful quality-of-life changes and a brand new report to level up your drafting strategy.

🆕 New: Team Synergy Report
Inside the Insights > Analysis section, you’ll now find the Team Synergy Report – a brand new way to understand your most common team stacks. This report highlights which pairs of NFL teams most frequently appear together across your rosters (requires at least 2 players from 2 different teams). Great for tracking your stacking patterns!

🛠️ Fixes & Improvements
Loading Feedback: When generating draft targets (which can sometimes take a few seconds), you’ll now see a proper loading message so you're not left guessing.

ADP Sorting Fix: We’ve resolved a bug where forced ADP picks weren’t properly sorted. They now follow the correct order as expected.

More polish and customization features are on the way soon. As always, thanks for supporting Huddle Genius and happy drafting!

notes.title: Huddle Genius – Update 1.01j Now Live!
notes.content:
This update brings powerful new tools to help you draft smarter and manage your exposures with more precision than ever.

🔍 New: Drafted As Report (Exposure-Insights)
Get deeper insights into your player usage with the Drafted As Report, found in the Exposure-Insights section. This feature breaks down each player's value based on where you are drafting them in your lineup—exposing trends like which players are anchoring your builds and which are commonly filling in late.

⚙️ New: QB/TE3 Probabilities
Inside the Preferences tab, you can now set your own odds of drafting a:

Third Quarterback

When “Ignore Shared Exposure” is enabled for soft targets, we’ll now also apply this to similar players shown in the ADP-based recommendation list if that round is targeting a soft target.

notes.content:

We've enhanced how quarterbacks are selected by running multiple iterations to ensure better alignment with your team stack settings. This improves overall stack synergy and prevents early QB picks without proper support.

notes.title: Cam Ward who?
notes.content:
Underdog Fantasy changed Cam Ward to Cameron Ward which brought up some problems.

Previously, if two drafts had the same structure but used slightly different player names (e.g., "Cam Ward" vs. "Cameron Ward"), exposure data could be double-counted or misaligned. Going forward, if a generated exposure entry does not match any imported player, it will now be completely ignored for that draft. This prevents mismatched or duplicate exposure records and ensures cleaner, more accurate tracking across drafts.

As always - the safest exposures to use are directly from your source since they'll match the rankings you are imported (usually!)

notes.title: 🛠 Update: Matchup Targeting, QB Customization & Bye Week Tools!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! We've rolled out a quality-of-life update focused on [b]customization and clarity[/b], giving you more control over your draft strategy and better insight into your picks. Here's what's new:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔍 [b]Matchup Week Customization[/b][/h3][p]You can now configure which weeks the app considers for potential matchup stacks! Use the in-app GUI tools under [b]Settings[/b] to fine-tune the matchup targeting window to your preference (e.g., Weeks 16-17 only). This helps you identify high-value game stacks [i]when it matters most[/i].[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎯 [b]Soft Targeting Customization for QBs + Pass Catchers[/b][/h3][p]We've introduced new sliders to let you customize:[/p][list][*][p][b]Safety Buffer[/b] – how closely you want to target a player's average draft position (ADP).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reach Range[/b] – how far you're willing to stretch to grab a QB or a potential stack.[/p][/*][/list][p]This makes the soft targeting system more flexible and suited to [i]your[/i] playstyle and tolerance for risk.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧠 [b]Bye Week Helper Window[/b][/h3][p]Understanding your positional limits just got easier. The Bye Week panel now includes a small info window that breaks down:[/p][list][*][p]Desired roster counts per position (in green)[/p][/*][*][p]How many players you’ve taken with the same bye week (in blue)[/p][/*][/list][p]This math-based helper makes sure you’re never left guessing how close you are to your limits.[/p][hr][/hr][p]— The Dev Team 🏈[/p]

notes.title: It's Heating Up
notes.content:
[p][b]📢 Huddle Genius Patch Update – July 7, 2025[/b][/p][p]Hey everyone! We’ve just rolled out a new update packed with quality-of-life improvements and a critical fix. Here's what’s new in today’s patch:[/p][p]🪟 [b]Borderless Window Toggle[/b]
You can now switch between windowed and borderless mode more easily—perfect for multitaskers and multi-monitor setups![/p][p]📅 [b]Bye Week Logic Added[/b]
Bye week processing is now live! You’ll find settings to help you better manage player availability and optimize your draft strategy.[/p][p]🎯 [b]Soft Targets List Added[/b]
We’ve introduced a soft targets list at the bottom of the draft screen. Keep track of your sleeper picks or favorite targets without cluttering your main queue.[/p][p]🛠️ [b]Week 17 Matchup Fix[/b]
We fixed a critical issue that was affecting Week 17 matchup calculations. All projections and correlation logic should now reflect the correct final week matchups.[/p][p]As always, thanks for playing Huddle Genius and giving great feedback! Let us know what you think, and good luck in your drafts! 🏈[/p][p]— The Huddle Genius Team[/p]
